name: Crown of the Earth
summary: At the Pools of Arlithrien, Corithras Moonrage asks you to fetch water as Gnarlpine furbolgs turn violent. His account of Teldrassil begins with Malfurion Stormrage's disappearance after the Third War.

sections.title: A Perilous Moonwell
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage gives you a tourmaline phial and sends you to a moonwell southeast of Darnassus's entrance, along the Pools of Arlithrien. The Gnarlpine furbolgs were once peaceful, but now they lash out without warning. They ambush travelers and harry Sentinel patrols across the region. These skirmishes have become a threat to the night elves' new home.

sections.title: Fandral Staghelm's Ambition
sections.body: When you return with the filled phial, Corithras tells you how Teldrassil began. After the Third War, Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage vanished, leaving the Cenarion druids without a leader and divided. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm took the mantle of leadership in his absence. He urged the Circle of Ancients in Darkshore to set aside their mourning. The night elves, he argued, had to regain their lost immortality and heal their civilization by planting a vast new World Tree.

faq.q: Where is the moonwell for this quest?
faq.answer: The moonwell lies southeast of Darnassus's main entrance, along the southern shores of the Pools of Arlithrien.

faq.q: Why are the Gnarlpine furbolgs attacking?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine furbolgs, once a peaceful kin of bear-men, now suffer a dark, mindless rage across Teldrassil. Sentinels first mistook the attacks for isolated incidents, but they have spread into a constant danger to nearby settlements and patrols.
Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage vanished without explanation after the Third War. The Cenarion druids and night elf leaders do not know what became of him.

With Malfurion missing, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm took the lead among the druids. He persuaded the Circle of Ancients in Darkshore to raise a new World Tree, arguing that the kaldorei needed it to rebuild and regain the immortality lost with Nordrassil's destruction.

angles.text: As a night elf, you hear how Teldrassil began after Malfurion's sudden disappearance, and learn of the political choice behind its planting.
As a druid, you hear how Fandral Staghelm's leadership divided the Cenarion Circle as he pressed to regain the night elves' ancient immortality.
